title: Q*bert
shortDescription: Q*bert helps define a Game Boy Color action and platformer and puzzle path in GameAtlas through original editorial framing and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Places a source-linked action and platformer and puzzle entry in the Game Boy Color browsing path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.
